newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* Philippine stocks are likely to soften due to inflation fears following the recent oil price hike and uncertainties in the foreign exchange market, Manila traders said on Tuesday.
*Henry Ong, research director at Sapphire Securities, said the the market expected year-on-year July inflation to rise between five and six percent from the previous month's 4.8.
The National Statistics Office is set to release the figures at 9 a.m. (0100 GMT) today.
* Sun Hung Kai Securities said it expected the composite index to trade within the 2,550-2,750 range.
"Investors are entering the market, but only in trickles and only for the short-term, selling at the slightest profit," it said in an advisory.
* The composite index ended up 3.89 points to 2,639.53 on Monday.
* The peso closed at 28.60 to the dollar on Monday from the previous 28.99.
* The interbank call loan rate closed at 20.625 percent.
